subject.title: improve(google): identify OpenClaw Gemini API traffic

question: Should OpenClaw reserve `x-goog-api-client` for `openclaw/<version>` on official Gemini endpoints, including replacing configured same-named headers, or should caller-provided partner attribution be preserved/appended?
rationale: The implementation follows the existing protected attribution policy shape, but applying it to Google changes outbound provider-header behavior for existing configurations and needs explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept protected OpenClaw attribution
options.body: Land this direction after live proof if maintainers want official Gemini traffic to be identifiable as OpenClaw even when a configured same-named header exists.

options.title: Preserve caller attribution
options.body: Require a patch that appends or preserves caller-provided `x-goog-api-client` values while still adding OpenClaw attribution where possible.

options.title: Pause the default policy
options.body: Keep Google as SDK-hook-only until maintainers decide the permanent provider-attribution contract.

recommendation.title: Accept protected OpenClaw attribution
recommendation.body: Land this direction after live proof if maintainers want official Gemini traffic to be identifiable as OpenClaw even when a configured same-named header exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is in the shared provider attribution/request policy area that vincentkoc introduced and maintained.
